name: Sengoku dark-age policy choice on the 15 km Japan map: the human house (Takeda), forced dark at the Koji 改元 (turn 66), gets its default, sees the choice screen, chooses Temple Learning via EXECUTE_SCRIPT (flags applied, a second choice dropped) and keeps it across a turn and save/load; dark AI houses take their own defaults

steps.code: local l = Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER'); if type(l) ~= 'table' then error('no ledger property') end; local elapsed = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() - GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 1; local takeda; for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() == 'CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA' then takeda = p:GetID() end end; if takeda == nil then error('Takeda (the human) not alive') end; local h = l.houses['p' .. takeda]; local defaults = {}; for row in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuDarkAgePolicyDefaults() do defaults[row.CivilizationType] = row.PolicyType end; local function flags(id, policy) local anchors = 0; for _, c in Players[id]:GetCities():Members() do local plot = Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(), c:GetY()); for row in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuDarkAgePolicies() do local on = row.PolicyType == policy; if (plot:GetProperty(row.PolicyType) or 0) ~= (on and 1 or 0) then error(row.PolicyType .. ' flag of ' .. id .. ' (policy ' .. tostring(policy) .. ')') end; local a = plot:GetProperty((string.gsub(row.PolicyType, '^JAC_AGE_POLICY_', 'JAC_AGE_ANCHOR_'))) or 0; if a ~= 0 and not on then error('stray anchor of ' .. id) end; anchors = anchors + a end end; if Players[id]:GetCities():GetCount() > 0 and anchors ~= 1 then error('anchors of ' .. id .. ': ' .. anchors) end end; if elapsed ~= 65 or l.reign ~= 0 then error('not turn 65 before Koji: ' .. elapsed .. ' reign ' .. l.reign) end; if defaults.CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA == 'JAC_AGE_POLICY_TEMPLE' then error('the test chooses Temple Learning, which must not be the default') end; h.score = -1000; Game:SetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER', l); return 'turn 65: forced Takeda (player ' .. takeda .. ') to score -1000 before the Koji judgement'

' flag of ' .. id .. ' (policy ' .. tostring(policy) .. ')') end; local a = plot:GetProperty((string.gsub(row.PolicyType, '^JAC_AGE_POLICY_', 'JAC_AGE_ANCHOR_'))) or 0; if a ~= 0 and not on then error('stray anchor of ' .. id) end; anchors = anchors + a end end; if Players[id]:GetCities():GetCount() > 0 and anchors ~= 1 then error('anchors of ' .. id .. ': ' .. anchors) end end; if elapsed ~= 66 then error('not turn 66: ' .. elapsed) end; if l.reign ~= 1 or type(l.history.r1) ~= 'table' or l.history.r1.turn ~= 66 then error('Koji not judged on turn 66') end; if h.age ~= 'DARK' then error('forced Takeda not dark: ' .. tostring(h.age)) end; if h.policy ~= defaults.CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA or h.chosen ~= nil then error('Takeda before choosing: ' .. tostring(h.policy) .. ' chosen ' .. tostring(h.chosen)) end; flags(takeda, h.policy); local dark = 0; for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id = p:GetID(); local x = l.houses['p' .. id]; local civ = PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName(); if x.age == 'DARK' then dark = dark + 1; if x.policy ~= defaults[civ] then error('default of ' .. civ .. ': ' .. tostring(x.policy)) end; flags(id, x.policy) elseif x.policy ~= nil then error('policy of non-dark ' .. civ) end end; return 'Koji (turn 66): Takeda dark on its default ' .. h.policy .. '; ' .. dark .. ' dark houses, each on its own default'

condition.code: local p = Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p ~= nil and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: if ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('choice screen hidden after load for the dark human house') end; return 'choice screen shown: ' .. tostring(Controls.Body:GetText())

if not JAC_ChooseDarkPolicy('JAC_AGE_POLICY_TEMPLE') then error('not sent: local turn not active') end; if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('screen still open after choosing') end; return 'Temple Learning sent via EXECUTE_SCRIPT'

' chosen=' .. tostring(h.chosen)
